intro: Astral Knot Garment is the culmination of a dedicated crafting endeavor in Stormwind City. After braving the wilds to gather rare spider silk, an adventurer presents the materials to the skilled tailor Wynne Larson. The result is a fine, magical weave suited for both treacherous journeys and high-society gatherings.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Your garment is ready! And that silk you gathered was so nice... You don't mind if I made it a little short so that I'd have some silk left over for me, do you?
I'm only joking. It'll fit you great, and will be perfect for both adventure and formal dining. Enjoy!

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
